name: O3 Mining Inc.
summary: O3 Mining Inc. engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of precious mineral deposits in Canada. It primarily explores for gold deposits. The company holds 100% interests in the Kan properties, the Élénore Opinaca property located in Northern Québec, Launay property located in the Abitibi Greenstone Belt of Québec, the Marban project located in Québec, and the Siscoe East project located in Québec. Its projects cover approximately 137,000 hectares in Québec. O3 Mining Inc. is based in Toronto, Canada.
